cases.description: Create a valid MANIFESTO.md from sufficient evidence.
Required identity evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Does not preserve it as canonical identity
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material turns the manifesto into a requirements document, roadmap, or policy directive.
expected: Keeps operational requirements out of the manifesto
prohibited: Embedding requirements or policy directives inside the manifesto

cases.description: The request is to produce a product requirements document rather than a statement of beliefs and commitments.
expected: Declines to use this skill for requirements documentation
Identifies the correct artifact for the request
Avoids producing a MANIFESTO.md for a non-qualifying request
prohibited: Producing MANIFESTO.md for a requirements or planning request
